'''Tobix Chasser''' was a [[human]] [[Imperial officer]] [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] who served as a [[Junior Lieutenant|junior grade lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army]]. He acted as operations personnel on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]], where he was in charge of assigning personnel to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] that had been constructed there.

In [[1 BBY]], Chasser was guarding [[Landing Platform Nine]] on Scarif when the [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|cargo shuttle]] [[SW-0608]] arrived secretly carrying a [[Rogue One|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] planning to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans]]. Oblivious to the infiltrators, Chasser opened the door to a [[Railspeeder|tram]] station for a group of disguised rebels. He then participated in the ensuing battle, which ended with the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial facility]] on Scarif being destroyed by the [[Death Star]].

==Biography==
===Death Star deployer===
{{Quote|Cargo shuttle SW-0608, be prepared to receive inspection team.|Frobb|audio=Frobb.flac|<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
Tobix Chasser was a [[human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer]] [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] in the [[Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Junior Lieutenant|junior grade lieutenant]].<ref name="SWROUVG" /> Chasser was stationed at the [[Imperial Center of Military Research]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]], where construction of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] was completed in [[orbit]]. Chasser was the member of operations personnel who was in charge of allocation of staff to the [[Death Star]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> with many of those who knew that the [[weapon]] was nearly operational vying for assignments on board.<ref name="SWROUVG" /> The lieutenant handpicked staff to ensure that only those who were both qualified and able to keep a secret were selected.<ref name="Geektionary" />

[[File:Frobb_on_landing_pad.png|thumb|left|300px|Chasser (left, stood beside console) was on Landing Platform Nine when SW-0608 arrived.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Chasser was working as a guard<ref name="Novel" /> at the [[control panel]] of [[Landing Platform Nine]] in the Imperial complex on Scarif and was stood with<ref name="RO" /> its [[deck officer]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Frobb]],<ref name="SWROUVG" /> and a [[stormtrooper]] when the Imperial [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|cargo shuttle]] [[SW-0608]] landed there. The [[shuttle]] had been directed to land on the platform, but secretly carried a [[Rogue One|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] who had [[Mission to Eadu|stolen]] it from an [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Imperial complex]] on the planet [[Eadu]]. The members of the Alliance hoped to infiltrate Scarif's [[Citadel Tower]] and [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the Death Star from the [[Scarif vault|data vault]] there.<ref name="RO" />

===Battle of Scarif===
{{Quote|Go! Go now! You're clear!|Bodhi Rook signals the rebels that Chasser and the other Imperials are distracted|<ref name="RO" />}}
Unaware of the rebels onboard, Frobb sent an inspection team onto SW-0608 where the Imperials were subdued by the infiltrators and had their [[Imperial military uniforms|uniforms]] [[Thief|stolen]]. While the inspection team were inside the [[Starship|vessel]], Chasser, Frobb, and the stormtrooper remained at the control panel, and once the rebel [[pilot]] [[Bodhi Rook]] saw<ref name="RO" /> that they were distracted<ref name="RO AD">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> from inside the shuttle's [[cockpit]], he called down for the other rebels to begin sneaking out of the ship. A group of [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|Alliance Special Forces]] members then climbed out of a hatch in the bottom of the shuttle and began sneaking off the platform into the surrounding [[Plant|foliage]].<ref name="RO" />

[[File:TobixChaser-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Tobix Chasser allowed Jyn Erso, Cassian Andor, and K-2SO into the Citadel Tower, where they would steal the Death Star plans.]]
As the other rebels exited the back of the vessel, the rebels [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[Jyn Erso]] exited the front disguised as the members of the inspection team and accompanied by the reprogrammed Imperial [[KX-series security droid]] [[K-2SO]].<ref name="RO" /> Oblivious to what was happening,<ref name="RO AD" /> Chasser barely glanced at the group<ref name="Junior">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> before pulling a lever on the control panel and opening the door<ref name="RO" /> to the [[Railspeeder|tram]] station<ref name="RO AD" /> that connected the landing platform to the Citadel Tower for the disguised rebels.<ref name="RO" />

The other rebels succeeded in leaving the platform without being noticed and began planting charges around the Imperial complex, which they then detonated, drawing [[Scarif Deployment|Imperial forces]] out of the Citadel Tower and into [[Ground warfare|combat]].<ref name="RO" /> Chasser took part in the battle,<ref name="Geektionary" /> which ended with the rebels that Chasser had allowed into the tower successfully transmitting the Death Star plans to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] before the Death Star destroyed the entire Imperial complex on Scarif with its [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]].<ref name="RO" />

==Personality and traits==
Tobix Chasser had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and gray [[eye]]s.<ref name="SWROUVG" />

==Equipment==
Chasser wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] including a gray [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]]. His uniform also included a black [[belt]] with a second disk on the buckle, a [[code cylinder]] worn on each [[breast]] of his [[Clothing|tunic]], and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with two blue pips.<ref name="SWROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FrobbDeletedScene.png|thumb|right|300px|Tobix Chasser appeared in a scene cut from the film's final release.]]
Tobix Chasser was created for the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="RO" /> and first appeared simultaneously in the film, its [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Alexander Freed]],<ref name="Novel" /> and its [[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] by [[Matt Forbeck]],<ref name="Junior" /> all of which were released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref> Prior to the release of the film, Chasser was first revealed in a promotional featurette for ''Rogue One'' released on [[November 17]], 2016.<ref name="Featurette">{{SWYouTube|u5sdztM-p98|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Featurette|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-intro-featurette}}</ref>

The character was first identified in reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="SWROUVG" /> and also released on the same day as the film.<ref name="SW.com" /> Production footage from the film shows a scene being filmed in which Frobb confronts K-2SO on the landing platform while Chasser watches;<ref name="TheRebel">{{HomeVideoCite|film=Rogue One|featurette=Jyn: The Rebel}}</ref> however, this did not make it into the final release.<ref name="RO" />
